messages:
mira: opened a quick docs PR to add the status page permalink + a short workaround for today's inference incident. need 1-2 reviewers and a green preview so we can merge before the customer sync.
alex: drop the PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/510 — adds status.redwood.com link to /operational/incidents, Known Issue: KV-cache invalidation during autoscaler failover, small SDK retry examples and a migration blurb.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #510 — missing include: incidents/snippets/status-link.md (see CI logs).
sam: I can add the snippet and do a prose pass.
ops-bot: Preview rebuild queued for PR #510.
mira: added the include and pushed. re-run requested.
ops-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-510--docs.redwood.com — please check the Known Issue render.
alex: nit on python sample: use timeout_ms and explicit backoff params. e.g.:
```python
client.generate(model=\"redwood-7b\", prompt=\"...\", timeout_ms=120000, max_retries=4, backoff_ms=250)
```
sre_lucy: please also include the detection query we used and a permalink to the status incident under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) by (model)
```
status permalink: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-3
mira: added promql, status link, and updated SDK snippets per alex. pushed.
sam: running a quick staging smoke after promotion. @ops-bot promote please.
ops-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #510 — expected ~4m.
sam: staging smoke: no 5xx regressions, latency normal. approve from me.
merge-bot: All approvals present for PR #510. final CI checks running.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #510.
merge-bot: PR #510 merged into main by mira at 1762003745. changelog entry queued.
alex: thanks — i'll alert support to link the KB to the new page.
mira: thank you everyone. will follow up with a tiny postmortem note and backport to internal runbook.
